biography.name: Nury Barragán
biography.experience: Dance instructor with 35 years of experience, with an extensive career performing and teaching in renowned artistic venues.
biography.title: Biography
paragraphs: Nury Barragán was born in Colombia, in Santafé de Bogotá. Her parents discovered her artistic and athletic abilities at a very early age, when she was only 5 years old.

After more than seven years of rigorous training in Olympic gymnastics and yoga, Nury Barragán became attracted to dance and began perfecting her skills in classical ballet, jazz, Colombian and international folklore, and eventually contemporary dance.
Nury Barragán very quickly joined the BALLET NACIONAL DE COLOMBIA, an ambassador of Colombia throughout the world, as well as BALLET TIERRA COLOMBIANA and BALLET FOLKLORICO COLOMBIANO.
These prestigious and important dance companies gave her the opportunity to perform as a soloist in countless shows presented on some of the most renowned and distinguished stages around the world.
This extensive, rich and varied professional experience led Nury Barragán to share her knowledge with children, adults, senior citizens and people with disabilities.
At the same time, Nury Barragán created her own dance company in Colombia during the 1990s.
Several years later, she worked for Colombian national television networks, café-concerts, musical theatre productions and sporting events, and participated in various events as a guest of honor.
Always driven by her athletic and competitive spirit, Nury Barragán developed a strong passion for competitions, acrobatics and Olympic gymnastics.
In 1994, she became a three-time national and international champion in sports aerobics, sports dance and aerobic marathons, competing among more than 2,500 participants.

Nury Barragán subsequently obtained certifications and diplomas in Fitness, Sports Medicine, Aqua Gym Fitness, Stretching and Relaxation Techniques, Sports Aerobics Competition Judging, Olympic Gymnastics, Pilates, Les Mills and Vinyasa Yoga.
She has worked as a Fitness Instructor, Zumba Fitness Instructor and speaker at International Aerobics Congresses and Aerobics Marathons.
She is also an author, creator and presenter of the project “Folklore Applied to Aerobics”, a judge at Olympic Gymnastics Championships and a Relaxation Techniques Instructor for senior citizens.

In addition, she has worked as a trainer and educator of final-year Gerontology university students at the University of San Buenaventura, with the research topic “Corrective and Preventive Gymnastics for Senior Citizens”.
In 1997, Nury Barragán decided to leave Colombia, her native country, and move to Europe.
She first arrived in Milan, Italy, where she lived for some time. Later, a work contract brought her to Paris.
Always guided by the humanitarian spirit that characterizes her, Nury Barragán has volunteered with important associations and rehabilitation centers for people with disabilities.
She has shared all her knowledge as a Dance Instructor and Zumba Fitness Instructor in both Colombia and France.
Today, with more than 35 years of experience, her dream has finally become a reality with the creation of her own dance school.
A one hundred percent Latin and authentic school, where she develops all styles of Latin dances, the folk dances of her country, Colombia, as well as the different specialties of Zumba.

items.name: Mathieu Morel
items.text:
Nury is a true ray of sunshine. Her overflowing energy and contagious joy for life turn her classes, whether Zumba, Body Pump, or Pilates, into genuine moments of enjoyment, exercise, and sharing.

Nury is an excellent instructor who is truly dedicated to her students. She is highly attentive and demonstrates all the exercises while correcting body positioning in order to help prevent injuries.

Kind and always attentive, she also knows how to adapt to each student’s individual fitness level and condition.

items.name: Marchal Yannick
items.text:
Nury is a very dynamic coach.

Her classes are highly appreciated and are of a very high standard, and they are always taught in a cheerful and positive atmosphere.

items.name: Elodie Violté
items.text:
A huge thank you to Nury for all the energy, joy, and passion she shares with us in every Zumba class.

She is a wonderful instructor, always smiling and incredibly dedicated.

Thank you so much for these wonderful moments we share together!

items.name: Laura Toucinho
items.text:
It is a real pleasure to take part in Nury’s Zumba classes!

She is always smiling, energetic, and full of positive energy. It feels great to let go, dance to music, and have fun. Thank you, Nury, for introducing me to this!

items.name: Loubna Boudaouch
items.text:
I love the Zumba classes! I really enjoy the atmosphere, which is always friendly and energetic. The steps are varied, fun, and enjoyable to follow.

Nury is incredibly motivating and brings so much energy to every class. It is always a pleasure to come dance and exercise in such a great atmosphere!
